reason: [OPUS-5] sq-559dp intentionally changes ALWAYS-COMPILED sparq-core code: `CompressedPerm::encode_emit` loses its `#[cfg(feature = "mmap")]` gate (it becomes an `#[inline]` always-compiled entry point) and the in-RAM compressed profile `TripleStore::from_triples_compressed` now encodes through it instead of calling `CompressedPerm::encode` directly, so the SPQCPRM2 emit gate is honoured in exactly one place for both the on-disk save path and the in-RAM path. sparq-wasm's default build consumes sparq-core, so moving that call site is expected to move the feature-OFF bundle bytes. This is NOT a `vectorized` (or any other default-OFF feature) leak: `spqcprm2` implies `mmap`, both are OFF in the feature-OFF wasm build, so the `emit_format()` branch inside `encode_emit` compiles out entirely and the emitted block stream stays V1 — the movement is codegen-level (an extra always-compiled entry point plus the resulting inlining/emission-order shift), not a new default-on capability, and query/store behaviour with the feature OFF is unchanged. NO byte delta is claimed here: the wasm32-unknown-unknown std component cannot be installed in the authoring checkout (read-only toolchain), so the base-vs-head comparison was NOT reproduced locally — CI leg 2 performs the actual byte comparison, and the accepted SIZE remains governed separately by the `metrics.wasm_bundle_bytes` +/-2% floor ratchet in bench/perf-baseline.json / bench.yml.
